texts.name: Jangaard
texts.biography: Jangaard, inherently cruel, was once feared throughout Raven Shore's pirate crew. He now appears to have joined Kastore's guard, serving his ruthless master. On the battlefield, Jangaard always delivers a surprise attack.

specialty.description: Increases the Speed of any Gunslingers or Bounty Hunters by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 6 levels (rounded up).
specialty.name: Gunslingers
